measurement.source: tissue_reference collect.replay successful attempt in run_manifest.json

scaling_illustration.basis: The 14.94 million accepted ten-second clips from scale_envelope.json

scope: The replay measurement uses finalized successful source rollouts and includes camera rendering and HDF5 recording. It excludes reconstruction, source-expert optimization, failed-attempt rendering, LeRobot conversion, vision-policy training, and setup. The projection holds resolution, frame rate, camera count, scene complexity, and GPU model fixed; it is an order-of-magnitude illustration rather than a production forecast.
